items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...if you ever played with her. She used to be with Celestan or Emma Barrett. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, yeah, yeah.

ctx.x: I worked with her a good many times, yeah. I think I worked with her originally. And that before carnival, I think it was during the carnival season, gone. I worked at Brennan's, up here on the... Yeah, I worked there. She was at the absent house. Yeah. She lost, I think she lost out there. Yeah, she's not there anymore now. She had that job, you see.
I just wondered in the old days, a long time ago, 30 years or so ago, if you ever played with her. She used to be with Celestan or Emma Barrett.
